name: Sigil of the Hammer
summary: The Sigil of the Hammer is a sign used to approach scholars who hold Yagyin’s Digest. It opens a path to knowledge sought for protection.

sections.title: A Sign of Learning
sections.body: A tablet points toward a digest written by Yagyin, and the Sigil of the Hammer is the sign that opens the way to it. In Ironforge, Gerrig Bonegrip keeps a shop in the Forlorn Cavern. In the Undercity, Keeper Bel'dugur tends a collection of books. Show the sigil to either scholar and ask for the digest.

faq.q: What is the Sigil of the Hammer for?
faq.answer: The Sigil of the Hammer identifies its bearer to scholars who can be asked for Yagyin's Digest.

faq.q: Who do I show the sigil to?
faq.answer: Show the Sigil of the Hammer to Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge or Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity.
Gerrig Bonegrip keeps a shop in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge.
Keeper Bel'dugur is in the Undercity, where he tends a collection of books.
The digest holds knowledge sought to protect those who seek it.

attribution: To the Undercity for Yagyin's Digest
